headline.purpose: Antonio major section headings; live and contact have observed size overrides.

body.purpose: Base page text; individual descriptions are often smaller.

shadows.name: sleeve
shadows.purpose: Lifts the cover image above its mat.

shadows.name: player
shadows.purpose: Separates the fixed player from page content.

shadows.name: mobile-navigation
shadows.purpose: Separates the open menu from the hero.

motion.name: portrait-reveal
motion.purpose: Initial clip reveal and scale from 1.04 to 1.

motion.name: sleeve-hover
motion.purpose: Straightens the sleeve from -3deg on hover; release selection does not animate it.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Button hover, navigation underlines, contact rotation, and disclosure icon.

motion.name: live-image-hover
motion.purpose: Scales the live feature image to 1.035.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes all animation and transitions, smooth scrolling, and sleeve rotation.

components.css: .ds-credits{background:var(--lavender,#dfdeec);color:var(--ink,#192522);border-top:1px solid #b9b8c8;border-bottom:1px solid #b9b8c8;font-family:Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:24px 0;font-size:20px;font-weight:700}.ds-summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-summary svg{transition:transform .2s}.ds-credits[open] .ds-summary svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-credit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr 1fr;align-items:center;gap:20px;border-top:1px solid #c6c5d2;padding:17px 0}.ds-credit h3{margin:0;font-size:12px}.ds-credit p,.ds-credit span{margin:0;font-size:10px}.ds-summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #db7200;outline-offset:6px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-credit{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:4px}.ds-summary{font-size:18px;padding:20px 0}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-summary svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: A large condensed name, a real studio portrait, and full cobalt sections give the page its identity. Release sleeves, restrained track rows, and specific credits support listening and browsing. This scan records the implemented static site, including the paper utility footer and sleeve hover behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Antonio display type and Manrope reading text.
Cobalt hero and contact sections; paper utility footer.
Original release artwork and documentary images.
Two selectable releases with a persistent native-audio preview player.

rules.name: Fixed palette
rules.body: Keep the implemented light palette across operating-system themes.

rules.name: Limited shadows
rules.body: Use depth for the sleeve, fixed player, and open mobile navigation.

dos: Do use real photographs and original work.
Do preserve accurate credit roles and source links.
Do preserve keyboard focus, native disclosure, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not add fake equalizers or invented credits.
Do not turn every project into a rounded shadowed card.
